OUR STORY

A local carpenter you can rely on

Will
Founder, Maltings Carpentry & Renovations

I'm Will, and I run Maltings Carpentry & Renovations, based in Snape, Suffolk. With over 15 years' experience in the building industry, I work on everything from fitted wardrobes, bespoke cabinetry and kitchens through to house builds, extensions and renovations.

As an independent carpenter, I deal with every project personally, from the initial conversation to the layout and proportions to materials, finishes and the finer details, I can offer advice and ideas throughout the project to help bring the right solution together.

I work across Suffolk, including Aldeburgh, Saxmundham, Woodbridge, Framlingham, Ipswich and Bury St Edmunds. If you're further afield, get in touch anyway - I may still be able to help.
